# `vox-tensor`

**Crate:** `vox-tensor` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Pure-CPU JSONL data loaders / training-pair types (Burn extracted 2026-05-08).

## Crate Overview

Pure-CPU data loaders and replay buffers for Vox training pipelines.

Used by:
- `vox-corpus` for corpus extraction
- `vox-ml-cli` for training data preparation
- `vox-plugin-mens-candle-cuda` for QLoRA training data ingestion


## Workspace Dependencies

| Dependency | Kind |
|---|---|
| [`vox-actor-runtime`](./vox-actor-runtime.generated.md) | Normal |

## Public API Surface

### Modules

| Module | Description |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pure-Rust tokenizer and JSONL DataLoader — always compiled, no GPU required. |
| `replay` | Experience replay buffer for catastrophic forgetting mitigation — always compiled, no GPU required. |
